name: python-scanner-class-move
body: The Python frontend's scanner unit is `rust.pyfrontend.scanner.Scanner.module_fqn_for`, declared in `src/pylib/scanner.rs`, and its identity helper is `rust.pyfrontend.identity.dotted_identity`. The module `rust.pyfrontend` and the units `parse_args`, `run`, `Args`, `usage`, `read_target_set`, and `ensure_artifact_dir` live in the crate root and keep their flat FQNs.
